jobs.description: About Our Company We’re a diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. Our team of 22,000 people across 19 countries, serves more than 3.5 million individual, small business and institutional clients. We are a longstanding leader in financial planning and advice, a global asset manager and an insurer. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our unique businesses – Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities. Here, we foster meaningful careers, invest in the future, and make a difference for clients, institutions and communities around the world. Job Description The Opportunity As Director, Product Management, Deposit Products, you will lead the strategy, performance, and lifecycle management of consumer checking, savings, and certificate of deposit products. You will shape product vision, influence enterprise priorities, and drive growth through pricing, analytics, customer acquisition, and innovation. This role offers significant exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to deliver meaningful business and client impact across banking and wealth management. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the long-term strategy, roadmap, and vision for consumer deposit products aligned with client, business, and enterprise objectives . Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, including ideation, research, business case, product design and requirements, launch, optimization, and governance. Serve as senior product leader for complex cross-functional initiatives involving technology, operations, finance, marketing, risk, compliance, and sales partners. Create deposit pricing strategies, forecasting, profitability management, balance growth, and financial performance monitoring in partnership with finance and treasury teams. Leverage analytics, reporting, and customer insights to optimize product performance, acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value. Ensure compliant, client-centered experiences by overseeing regulatory requirements, disclosures, policies, and risk management activities. Communicate product strategy, results, risks, and recommendations to executive stakeholders while influencing decisions across the organization. Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing product management teams, fostering accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. This position may be located in Charlotte, NC or Minneapolis, MN. Required Qualifications 10+ years of relevant experience, including 5+ years of consumer deposit product management or similar consumer banking product management experience Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field ​ Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in business , f inance, e conomics, or a related field Demonstrated success developing, launching, pricing, and scaling bank deposit products within complex financial services environments Strong expertise in product management, deposit pricing, financial modeling, forecasting, profitability analysis, and data-driven decision making Working knowledge of analytics, performance reporting , and customer behavior analysis Experience partnering with marketing teams to design, measure, and optimize acquisition and engagement campaigns Knowledge of wealth management organizations, core banking platforms, and fintech ecosystems Exceptional leadership, communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills with a proven ability to lead cross-functional teams Visa Sponsorship Applicants must have a valid work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship for employment in the United States (e.g., H-1B, F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, TN). In-Office Collaboration We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1) day per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process. Base Pay Salary The estimated base salary for this role is $131,000 - $180,100 / year. We have a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy. Your initial total compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location. In addition, most of our roles are eligible for variable pay in the form of bonus, commissions, and/or long-term incentives depending on the role. We also have a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being, including but not limited to vacation time, sick time, 401(k), and health, dental and life insurances. jobs.description: Software Test & Verification Engineer (Experienced/Senior) Company: The Boeing Company The Boeing Company is looking for a Software Test & Verification Engineer (Experienced/Senior) to join the Ground Software Engineering team located in El Segundo, CA or Seal Beach, CA. This position will focus on supporting the Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS) Satellite Systems Software Engineering organization. Our team creates software tools and services for the world’s highest performing satellite/ground systems for USG and Commercial customers. We work with customers in the development of the next generation ground systems. This is an opportunity to work in a rapid development environment using modern technology, architecture, and tools. Our team works within an agile methodology using a CI/CD environment; integrated with automated testing, vulnerability, & quality scanning capabilities. Your skills and interests will be leveraged in conjunction with Systems Engineering and Software Development teams to deliver suites of automated regression tests and completed software products for delivery to customers. This senior position requires proven experience within the software ecosystem, a unique background of project experience, and the clear exhibition of superior judgment and decision making to engineer new solutions and capabilities. Critical thinking and troubleshooting skills are required! Position Responsibilities: Support verification development and review of the Test Cases, Test Procedures and conduct Informal and Formal Test Readiness Reviews (TRR). Leading Software Test Team in the formal verification of the software requirements. Leading Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) with the test team, maintaining the run log and daily report. Documentation of any issues and problem reports encountered during test using change control tools. Routine reporting of issue burnup charts and verification development status at program management review meetings. Tracking the status of open issues identified during development, informal and formal test execution to closure to meet the deliverables. Supporting/Analyzing internal and external customer Problem Report (PR) and acting as integrator for the Ground Mission Software working with Flight Software, Satellite Simulation, Ground Systems Engineering, and Ground Software leads. Release all the software life cycle documents per the Boeing Process. Leading team to meet the compliance to software development and verification processes in support of internal and external Audit with Quality Assurance team. Leading team to develop Software Verification Life Cycle documents. Support Change Control Board (CCB) activities related to Software Verification process. Support planning for Deliverables (Verification Plans, Requirement Deviations, Requirements, Test Reports etc) to meet program milestones. This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at one of the listed location options. Experience as a Product Owner/Technical Lead and/or Integration & Test Lead for government programs. Understanding of Command and Control (C2) systems, real-time applications, and their specific requirements. Experience with database technologies (SQL/NoSQL), messaging systems (e.g., Kafka, ActiveMQ), and data streaming technologies (e.g., CCSDS). Familiarity with containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration platforms. Knowledge of how to derive and allocate requirements (e.g., system, sub-system, software) and show traceability throughout the product lifecycle. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
We're hiring a policy generalist to join the Strategic Advisory team within Anthropic's Public Policy team. You'll develop and maintain our policy research strategy and lead the research behind it, to strengthen Anthropic's policy influence in Washington and around the world.
You'll lead the research that backs up Anthropic's policy positions: deciding what evidence a position needs, working with Anthropic's research teams on what our own data can show, building partnerships with outside academics, think tanks and economists, and managing our growing body of commissioned research and economic impact work. You'll turn that research into analysis and materials our federal, state and international teams can use. You'll also run the cross-functional processes that take an open policy question to an agreed, evidence-backed position. As Anthropic's international footprint grows, you'll help the team scale its research and support for markets outside the US.
You're likely a strong generalist who likes to build things and see them through, and who gets energy from turning complex research into something clear, organized and useful. You're curious and rigorous about evidence. You ask what would change a skeptic's mind, you can tell a strong study from a weak one, and you know when to bring in a subject matter expert. You have good judgment, you take initiative, and you're comfortable when the path isn't defined yet. You can run several research projects and outside partners at once while keeping track of how they connect.
Key responsibilities
Run policy development processes from open question to agreed position: frame the question, bring in the right experts from research, legal, communications and regional policy teams, work through disagreements, and get to a decision
Develop research plans for priority issue areas: what evidence would strengthen or test a position, what Anthropic's own data and research can show, and where an outside partner is the right source
Work with Anthropic's research teams, including economics research, Societal Impacts and the Frontier Red Team, to turn their findings into material policymakers can use
Manage commissioned research from scoping through publication, and build partnerships with outside academics, think tanks, economists and consultancies
Own economic impact reports and the narratives that go with them for markets around the world
Anticipate emerging policy issues and work with internal experts to develop Anthropic's perspective and supporting materials before external pressure builds
Scale the team's support for international markets: adapt strategy and materials for different governments, and build templates and processes so each new market is faster than the last
Draft briefings, talking points and other materials on short timelines, coordinating with policy communications so messaging stays consistent
Minimum qualifications
A track record of driving cross-functional projects to a decision or finished product, including getting people with competing interests to agreement when you don't manage them
Experience as a policy generalist across several issue areas, including designing and carrying out policy research and turning it into policy proposals or positions
Ability to scope a research question, work with economists, academics and other experts to answer it, and judge the quality of their evidence and methods, for example through economic consulting, a policy research organization, or an in-house research team
Excellent writing: you can turn complex technical or economic material into clear, concise memos, briefings and talking points for different audiences
An understanding of how a company's commercial interests and its policy positions fit together
Strong organization and project management, including running several projects and outside partners at once
A record of working independently, taking ownership of problems, and driving next steps and deliverables without being prompted
A collaborative, low-ego approach: you pitch in wherever the work needs you and share credit readily
Interest in AI policy and alignment with Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial
Preferred qualifications
5+ years of professional experience in technology policy, public affairs, consulting or a related field
Experience on an in-house technology policy team, in corporate public affairs, or in management or economic consulting, especially public sector or policy practices
Experience managing outside vendors, research partners or commissioned studies, including economic impact studies
A background in AI or technology policy
Relationships with academics, think tanks or research organizations working on AI or technology policy
Experience with international policy or supporting teams in multiple countries
Training in economics or quantitative methods

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. anthropic.com/careers
directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!

You work alongside FDE delivery pods in customer environments, getting hands-on with production code, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML pipelines. You work with senior security engineers who will mentor you, but you own real security deliverables from your first engagement. If you want to learn AI security by doing it, in production, at enterprise scale, this is the role. This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen. 쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

jobs.description: COMPANY OVERVIEW We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. This position is on 12 hours shifts and follows a 2 on, 2 off, 3 on, 2 off, 2 on, 3 off schedules. Each block rotates from days to nights every 2 weeks. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Perform and support operations technician in testing Vitamin C, pH, Brix, Water activity, Gilmont leak, sanitizer titration and any additional lab testing. Conducting Daily GMP and Process Audits in production and storage areas of the plant. Respond to calls from operations regarding potential food safety & quality issues and provide input and decision to continue run or place product on hold. Place out of specification (quality & food safety hold) product on hold in the system and perform counts of hold product. Investigate out of spec material as needed i.e. unsealed pouches to verify times of hold product. Collect retention samples and maintain retention area in Quality Main lab. Perform data entry into the various Quality System databases. Review on-line HACCP log sheets and various quality & sanitation related documents to assure compliance with company policies. Attend Shift DDS (Daily direction setting) and provide quality input and updates as needed. Cleaning and sanitation of Main Quality Fruit lab. Maintain quality related documentation (Sanitation paperwork, Daily inspections, calibrations records) Perform environmental swabbing of equipment, production & warehouse areas. Perform calibrations and verifications at set frequency of lab equipment (scales, titrator, etc.), production equipment (metal detectors, Screens, strainers magnets etc.). Perform Glass & plastic audits of production & warehouse areas. Present training in Quality subjects to new and existing employees. Support routine maintenance and troubleshooting of lab equipment. Lead shift sensory program. Send samples for FPPT (finished product pathogen testing) and place on hold/release in system. Request sanitation chemicals for shutdown cleaning from the sanitation department. Maintain lab chemical, sanitation chemical, lab waste lab equipment inventory. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Data Center Security Engineering (DCSE) secures Anthropic's data center footprint; this role covers how the sites are designed and built to be secure. Much of that footprint is designed and built with partners, so a site's security is decided early: in what Anthropic hands the people who build it, and in how rigorously the delivered systems are tested against it.
You'll design and specify the physical security systems for a site: perimeter and vehicle barriers, intrusion detection, video, security lighting, and the site penetrations and utility entry points that bypass them. Design firms and integrators produce the site drawings and install; you specify, review, and verify. You'll write the performance requirement and verification method behind each control, review every site design against them at each stage with redlines a design team can act on, test in the field that what was built performs as specified, and re-verify post-acceptance changes.
This is a foundational role. You'll own Anthropic's physical security reference design package (typical details, reference drawings, schedules, and test procedures) in the form partners build from, and keep it current against each site's threat basis and the sites actually being built. You'll set the technical position for a site and decide what applies where; where a requirement can't be met as written, you'll engineer the compensating control and document the deviation. You'll work with the rest of DCSE, with Anthropic's design, construction, and real estate counterparts, and directly with the vendors who build to the package. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.
The same seat covers the team's security operations control rooms. You'll set their design and operational requirements and accept delivered systems against them, working day to day alongside the team's platform engineers, who own the software and compute that run in them.
This role involves regular travel to data center sites. These are critical services, and this role participates in an on-call rotation for them.
Key responsibilities
Produce a vendor-ready design package
for perimeter barriers and hostile vehicle mitigation, intrusion detection and its zoning, video coverage, security lighting matched to camera performance, and penetration protection: performance specifications, typical details and reference drawings, and device and zone schedules, written so a design firm can build to them and a test can prove them
Define the per-site engineering basis:
which requirements apply to a site based on its risk profile and the threats it faces, with compensating controls and documented deviations
Write the acceptance criteria and test methods:
the verification method behind each requirement and the evidence a site must produce to pass acceptance
Set standoff, structural hardening, and site layout criteria
for new designs, tied to the threat basis they derive from
Run field verification:
commissioning and acceptance testing of perimeter, detection, video, and lighting against performance criteria (detection coverage tests, photometric measurements, video quality checks)
Write the operational and design requirements for security operations control rooms:
console layout, wall versus workstation content, supervisor placement; room network, power, backup, and resilient communications to the team's segmentation and hardening baseline
Own control room acceptance:
factory and site acceptance criteria written before the build, then accept or reject delivered systems (video wall, consoles, cabling, fit-out) against them
Minimum qualifications
